title: Author purpose Practice 2
description: 4 short texts - 8 focused author purpose questions
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Old Theater

A preservation letter asks donors to support repairs to a neighborhood theater and describes original murals hidden behind later wall panels.

TEXT B - Heat Advisory

A health notice tells readers how to recognize signs of heat exhaustion and when to seek emergency care.

TEXT C - Transit Report

A report compares weekday ridership before and after a route change, then explains which neighborhoods gained more frequent service.

TEXT D - Noise FAQ

A housing FAQ answers questions about quiet hours, construction noise, parties, and how residents can report repeated problems.

questions.prompt: What is the author's primary purpose?
questions.explanation: Persuade donors that restoring the theater is worth supporting.
questions.rule: Name the relationship first, then prove it with the surrounding text.

options.text: describe the theater’s history without asking readers to act
options.whyWrong: “describe the theater’s history without asking readers to act” could describe a minor effect, but it is not the primary purpose of the text.

options.text: persuade donors that restoring the theater is worth supporting
explain how later wall panels were installed
options.whyWrong: “explain how later wall panels were installed” captures only one part of the text and misses the larger idea the question asks about.

options.text: compare the theater with newer entertainment venues
options.whyWrong: “compare the theater with newer entertainment venues” uses a related idea but answers a different question from the one asked.
